fact: On 10 July 2026 the Ondo State education commissioner ordered all public and private primary and secondary schools to upload every enrolled learner's record to DNEMIS by 14 July 2026, reporting under 25 percent compliance against a 95 percent benchmark for HOPE-EDU funds.
title: Ondo Govt Sets July 14 Deadline for Learner Data Upload, on the Federal Government's Digital National Education Management Information System
publisher: Federal Ministry of Information and National Orientation
